primary_pde.case_curve: stitch the seed-20260723 hybrid segments 0-to-8 and 8-to-32, dropping the duplicate t=8 sample
primary_pde.reference_depth_alignment: linearly interpolate the dense Gram field from s=l/L to the PDE nodes s=j/N; for L=32 or 64 and N=16 this reduces exactly to subsampling
primary_pde.reference_time_alignment: require byte-equal time grids; interpolation in training time is forbidden

final_reference_selection.rule: use the preregistered n=256,L=32,S=24 held-out tier for heldout_cases and n=128,L=32,S=32 screening tier for every other case
final_reference_selection.depth_diagnostic_role: n=256,L=64,S=16 for I1 and I2 is diagnostic only and never substituted into the primary result

normalizations.gram_error: sup_{t,s} Frobenius norm of DeltaG_PDE-DeltaG_dense divided by max(sup||DeltaG_PDE||F,sup||DeltaG_dense||F,0.05)
normalizations.output_error: sup_t Euclidean norm of Deltaf_PDE-Deltaf_dense divided by max(||y||2,sup||Deltaf_PDE||2,sup||Deltaf_dense||2,0.1)
normalizations.loss_error: sup_t absolute difference between PDE loss and 0.5*||mean_dense_output-y||2^2 divided by max(PDE initial loss,dense-mean initial loss,0.1)
normalizations.active_gram_case: dense Gram motion divided by max_s ||G_dense(s,0)||F is at least 0.05
normalizations.rms: root mean square over all time, depth, and matrix entries; output RMS is over time and samples

uncertainty.screening_resampling: resample 16 trajectories with replacement independently inside each of the two fixed S=16 blocks; reuse the same resampled indices for every screening case
uncertainty.confirmation_resampling: resample 12 trajectories with replacement independently inside each of the two fixed S=12 blocks; reuse the same resampled indices for every confirmation case
uncertainty.mixed_final_family: screening and confirmation block draws are independent within each replicate; take the maximum centered statistic over all 14 final cases
uncertainty.simultaneous_ucb: observed metric plus the empirical 0.95 quantile of max_case(bootstrap_metric-observed_metric)
uncertainty.simultaneous_lcb: observed metric minus the empirical 0.95 quantile of max_case(observed_metric-bootstrap_metric)
uncertainty.multiplicity: use one additional maximum over the three normalized primary metrics, so the reported joint UCB/LCB is simultaneous over cases and metrics
uncertainty.outcome_rule: wide intervals are unresolved; no seed or case may be deleted

plateau.endpoint_output_drift: ||f(b)-f(a)||2 divided by the output normalization scale
plateau.endpoint_gram_drift: max_s ||G(s,b)-G(s,a)||F divided by the Gram normalization scale
plateau.output_tail_arclength: sum over recorded steps of ||f(t_k)-f(t_{k-1})||2 divided by output scale
plateau.gram_tail_arclength: sum over recorded steps of max_s ||G(s,t_k)-G(s,t_{k-1})||F divided by Gram scale
plateau.analytic_output_speed_pde: max over window of ||-Theta(t)(f(t)-y)||2 divided by output scale
plateau.analytic_output_speed_dense: max over window of ||mean_seed[-Theta_seed(t)(f_seed(t)-y)]||2 divided by output scale
plateau.loss_drift: absolute endpoint loss change divided by max(initial loss,0.1)
plateau.memberwise_p95: 95th percentile over dense seeds of max(normalized endpoint output drift,normalized endpoint Gram drift)
plateau.pass_rule: both PDE and dense reference must pass every threshold on both 8-to-16 and 16-to-32 windows
plateau.fixed_budget_rule: a failure at t=32 is reported as unresolved or a failure in this frozen study; no post-result horizon extension may enter the primary evidence

numerical_gates.scramble: compare primary and seed-20260724 hybrid PDE increments on t<=8; normalized Gram and output differences must each be <=0.01
numerical_gates.fallback_R256: if either scramble metric exceeds 0.01, run the primary seed with R=256 as a directional diagnostic, retain the frozen R=128 result, and mark that case numerically unresolved; the one-seed diagnostic cannot convert the trigger into a pass
numerical_gates.qmc: for B0,I1,I2 compare hybrid M81,R128 against QMC M256,R128; descriptive method crosscheck with 0.01 tolerance
numerical_gates.time: for I1,I2 compare dt=0.02 against dt=0.01; normalized Gram and output discrepancies <=0.005
numerical_gates.depth: for I1,I2 compare N=16 against N=32 after depth alignment; normalized Gram and output discrepancies <=0.005
numerical_gates.identity: max absolute loss_dot + e^T Theta e <=1e-10, minimum Theta eigenvalue >=-1e-10, and all values finite

decisions.strong_transfer: joint simultaneous 95% UCB <=0.05 for Gram, output, and loss, plus numerical and plateau gates; inactive Gram cases are judged only on output/loss and cannot count as Gram evidence
decisions.material_counterexample: joint simultaneous 95% LCB >0.10 in any judged primary metric, an active-Gram case with PDE/dense feature-motion ratio outside [0.5,2], or a plateau pass/fail mismatch
decisions.broad_non_ad_hoc: all 14 preregistered cases strongly transfer; otherwise report the exact boundary and never average failures away

secondary_outputs: unnormalized numerator and denominator for each metric
RMS-per-entry Gram and RMS-per-sample output errors
time and depth of every supremum
